texts: good. the whole scene lands in one fireable rule - keepers as the habitual doers, the threads as one definite group, the warm stone as what they come off, and each keeper's own flat blade as the tool.

good. everything is carried in one fireable rule: the well-attended restriction, the small heap of threads, the nightly slot and the moth-season window. The nightly cycle is recorded beside the moth-season window rather than inside it, so the two must be read together, but no rewording would express that any better.
